name: fitnessapp
description: PulseFit — full-stack fitness platform (React + Express + Prisma + PostgreSQL)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.vercel-build: npm run db:generate -w server && npm run db:deploy -w server && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
